title: Impact of Numerous Heavy Construction Projects
what_it_is: Impact of Numerous Heavy Construction Projects

sections.label: Construction impact assessment and enforcement
sections.summary: Agencies assess construction impacts on people, buildings, infrastructure and environment; NEA sets noise limits, LTA requires Transport Impact Assessments for large projects, and enforcement may include stop work orders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: When assessing development projects before construction is allowed to proceed, agencies take into account the impact of construction arising from that particular project on the people, the existing buildings and infrastructure, and the environment in the surrounding area.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: To minimise potential noise disamenities from construction works, the National Environment Agency imposes noise limits on construction sites under the Environmental Protection and Management Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For large-scale projects, the Land Transport Authority also requires developers to conduct a Transport Impact Assessment to identify the potential impact of construction on traffic flows and propose mitigation measures, where necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Enforcement action will be taken against developers who violate regulatory requirements, and a "stop work order" may be imposed on repeat offenders.
